title: qualification report: a red top_level gate names no failing test on the console (the (fail) lines live only in an escaped JSON line that gh run view --log-failed drops)
description: When a prepublication source gate fails, scripts/qualification/prepublish.mjs record() captures the child stdout and stderr, but the report is printed as ONE JSON document in which those fields are single escaped string lines, and gh run view --log-failed DROPS that line. So a red top_level gate (the grouped bun test invocation) names no failing test anywhere a reader normally looks: the gate name and exitCode are all that survive. Found while diagnosing QCLI-305 (opum-ai/quest-cli#576): the failing test was "(fail) the install recreates a destination on a FRESH INODE, never in place (QCLI-271)", test/qcli305-install-platform-candidates.test.ts:191, and it was recoverable ONLY from the raw job log via GET actions/jobs/<id>/logs, not from --log-failed, not from the run page, and not from any artifact (the failed run uploads none). Fix direction: the runner should additionally print each failing test (fail) line, and any error line, as PLAIN console output, so a red gate is diagnosable from the normal view. Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A prepublication source gate that fails prints the failing child (fail)/error lines as plain console lines as well as inside the JSON report, so gh run view --log-failed on the failed run names the failing test.
